text:
You need someone to help develop and execute entry-level marketing strategy across the enterprise while translating customer insights into action.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; 18% of ad budget was reallocated and CAC fell 12% the next quarter. In a parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and summarized findings for the board; 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan.

I can help organize customer insights, build clear reporting, and support strategy decisions with clean, actionable analysis.
